brief:
Margaret Owen OBE, a 94-year-old Jewish human rights barrister, was arrested for her support of Palestine Action, the activist group said. Owen, who has spent decades defending vulnerable populations and has received numerous accolades for her work in human rights law, spoke to Al Jazeera about the arrest.

The veteran lawyer is a longtime friend of Philippa Foot, the late mother of former UK Labour leader Ed Miliband. Owen's arrest marks an escalation in police actions against supporters and members of Palestine Action, which has staged disruptive protests at weapons manufacturers and military sites.
dek: Margaret Owen OBE, a celebrated human rights lawyer and friend of Ed Miliband’s late mother, talks to Al Jazeera.
title: Police arrest 94-year-old rights lawyer for supporting Palestine Action
